It's great that you've found a morning routine that helps you feel prepared and confident for the day. Taking extra time to shave and trim your beard can be a therapeutic and meditative experience, allowing you to focus on yourself and set a positive tone for the day ahead. Having a well-groomed beard can also boost your self-esteem and make you feel more put together, which can translate to other areas of your life. It's almost like a ritual that signals to yourself that you're ready to take on the day. It's also interesting that you mention feeling "prepared" after shaving and trimming your beard. This suggests that your morning routine is not just about physical grooming, but also about mental preparation. By taking care of your appearance, you're also taking care of your mental state, which can help you feel more focused and ready to tackle challenges. Overall, it's wonderful that you've found a routine that works for you and helps you feel your best. Keep taking that extra time to shave and trim your beard – it's clearly making a positive impact on your daily life!
